Section B: Fill in the Blanks (Understand)
Double precision format uses a total of 64 bits.
The exponent field in double precision is 11 bits long.
The exponent is stored with a bias of 1023 in double precision format.
The mantissa is composed of 52 bits and represents the fractional part.
The sign bit is set to 0 for positive numbers and 1 for negative numbers.
